q1_issues.issue: The dual-emit flat copular half is missing: the rule mints the per-member reified visible state but never yields (Member $x visible), which Core patterns (adjective's PP complement) and the resultative-plural note (flat half becomes (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (Member $x <state>))) both require.

notes: The reified-state route with the surface-preposition oblique From on the state witness is the right choice for an individuated bearer and complement (the fused sensitive_to_light form is bare-kinds-only), and distributing over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) instead of predicating on the group symbol is correct. Consequence of the omission: a plain "is that cliff-spire visible?" binds nothing.
